about.text: The buttermilk left in Ethiopia after kibe is churned from ergo, soured milk: drunk as it is, or heated to make ayib cheese.

links.name: Food Science & Nutrition (2024), review of Ethiopian fermented milk products

facts.v: Like ergo, thicker than fresh milk
The base for ayib, the Ethiopian cottage cheese
